title: Partitioned Co-Simulation for CAD-integrated Vibroacoustic Problems in Unbounded Domains
abstract: arXiv:2609.15384v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vibroacoustic analysis often requires coupling structural and acoustic solvers based on different numerical formulations and discretizations, making monolithic implementations intrusive and limiting software modularity and reuse. This work presents a partitioned co-simulation framework for exterior vibroacoustic analysis that couples an Isogeometric boundary representation analysis (IBRA) structural solver with an isogeometric boundary element method (IGA-BEM) acoustic solver. The methodology operates directly on the computer-aided design (CAD) boundary representation, preserving the exact geometry throughout the analysis and supporting both weak and strong coupling between non-conforming discretizations. translated_title: 面向无界域中CAD集成振动声学问题的分块协同仿真方法
translated_abstract: 振动声学分析通常需要耦合基于不同数值格式和离散化方法的结构求解器与声学求解器，这使得整体式（monolithic）实现具有很强的侵入性，并限制了软件的模块化与复用性。本工作提出了一种用于外域振动声学分析的分块协同仿真框架，将等几何边界表示分析（IBRA）结构求解器与等几何边界元方法（IGA-BEM）声学求解器相耦合。该方法直接在计算机辅助设计（CAD）边界表示上进行操作，在整个分析过程中保持精确几何，并支持非匹配离散化之间的弱耦合与强耦合。一个关键贡献是将Aitken动态松弛法与界面拟牛顿逆最小二乘法（IQN-ILS）收敛加速器扩展至复数值界面量，使耦合迭代得以……
tldr: 本文提出了一种在CAD精确几何上耦合IBRA结构求解器与IGA-BEM声学求解器的分块协同仿真框架，并将Aitken动态松弛和IQN-ILS收敛加速器扩展至复值界面量，实现了无界域外场振动声学问题的非侵入式弱/强耦合分析。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a partitioned co-simulation framework coupling an IBRA structural solver with an IGA-BEM acoustic solver directly on exact CAD geometry, with a key contribution being the extension of Aitken dynamic relaxation and IQN-ILS convergence accelerators to complex-valued interface quantities for non-intrusive exterior vibroacoustic analysis.
